description: Reviews AI/ML systems for data privacy and governance risks including training data privacy, PII exposure in prompts and completions, data retention policies, model memorization risks, and regulatory compliance. Auto-invoked when reviewing systems that process personal data through LLMs, train or fine-tune models on user data, or deploy AI in regulated industries. Produces a structured assessment mapped to NIST AI RMF 1.0 and OWASP LLM02:2025 (Sensitive Information Disclosure).
